_comment: Default reactive rules — fixed baseline. Do NOT edit this file. Use custom_rules.json for user overrides.

supplier._note: Reorder when available_supply < 40% capacity; order 30% capacity (~300 units)

farm._note: Reorder when feed_stock < 55% capacity; order 25% capacity

slaughterhouse._note: Reorder when input_inventory < 45% capacity; order 25% capacity

wholesaler._note: Reorder when inventory_level < 38% capacity; order 30% capacity (~90 units)

retail._note: Reorder when retail_inventory < 30% capacity; order 35% capacity (~53 units)

restock_interval._note: Interval dalam ticks (1 tick = 15 menit). Wholesaler: 8 ticks = 120 menit; Retail: 4 ticks = 60 menit

_disruption_note: 0–1: proporsi supply yang masih mengalir saat gangguan. 0.35 = 35% supply tetap mengalir
